turns.q: What happens if it already shipped — can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
already shipped — can it still be changed?

Hi — once an order has already shipped, it can’t be changed or canceled. 📦

That includes things like:

changing items
canceling the order
updating quantities
changing the shipping address in our system

If it’s a non-personalized order, you can usually return it after it arrives here: https://www.simplemodern.com/pages/returns-portal

If you want, send me your order number and I can help you figure out what options you still have 🙂

Because orders move through fulfillment quickly, each order is usually processed on its own.
